name: Linear
description: Linear agent webhook bridge for OpenClaw dev runs

devAgentId.description: Agent ID to handle Linear issues (default: 'dev')

linearWebhookSecret.description: Linear webhook signing secret for signature verification

linearApiKey.description: Linear OAuth token for posting activities and updating issues

notifyChannel.description: Optional channel to deliver agent responses (e.g., 'discord')

repoByTeam.description: Map Linear team keys to repository directories

repoByProject.description: Map Linear project keys to repository directories

defaultDir.description: Default repository directory when no team/project mapping matches

delegateOnCreate.description: Auto-delegate issues to the app user on session create (default: true)

startOnCreate.description: Move issues to 'started' state on session create (default: true)

externalUrlBase.description: Base URL for external session links (supports {session} and {issue} placeholders)

externalUrlLabel.description: Label for external session links (default: 'OpenClaw session')
